title: An Alternate Technique to Display Records
author: Tai BUI, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This pattern of hand-rolling a record container out of classic 4D Objects and array-of-objects to avoid Input-form locking predates both ORDA entity selections and the modern class-based object model; the same non-locking, multi-record-tab UX is far more naturally built today with ORDA entities (which are inherently lock-free until .save()) and 4D's native list box + form binding.
